clips.title: The story
paras: The Twilight Base Camp is a fortified outpost of the Twilight's Hammer cult situated in the arid wastes of Silithus. It serves as an active ritual site where cultists convene to commune with elemental powers and orchestrate their apocalyptic agenda. The camp is characterized by strange wind stones and heavily armed cult zealots.

Perched among the desolate sands of Silithus, the Twilight Base Camp is one of several enclaves established by the Twilight's Hammer cult. The outpost brims with zealots, geomancers, and stonecallers dedicated to summoning devastating elemental forces. Surrounded by jagged ritual stones, the camp acts as a staging ground where leaders like Twilight Keeper Havunth and Twilight Lord Everun direct efforts to hasten Azeroth's end, standing in open defiance of the Cenarion Hold forces attempting to restore balance to the region.

Scattered throughout the outpost are mysterious monuments known as wind stones, ranging in power from lesser conduits to greater monoliths. Through cryptic incantations and cult regalia, the Twilight's Hammer uses these focal points to pull chaotic elemental spirits directly into the physical realm. Disrupting these rituals remains a top priority for travelers and scouts hoping to prevent the cult's influence from spreading across Kalimdor.
